entry.title: Choosing the Right Tool: Selection Strategies for LLM Agents
entry.summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on external tools. We study how agents select among many candidate tools and propose a retrieval-based selector. Experiments on three benchmarks show large gains in accuracy while reducing prompt length. We further analyse failure modes where similar tool descriptions confuse the model, and we release our benchmark suite, evaluation harness, and all prompts so that others can reproduce and extend these results on new tool catalogues and agent frameworks.

entry.title: Securing the Model Context Protocol
entry.summary: We analyse the attack surface of MCP servers. Tool poisoning is the main risk.
